title: How can I send a screenshot to Help
question: How can I send a screenshot to Help?
answer: Open Help, describe the problem and use Attach a screenshot, or paste an image with Ctrl+V. The local vision model reads the support screenshot on the office machine; that support reading does not send it to a cloud model. If this does not match what you see, send a screenshot in Help.
looks_like: Help has Attach a screenshot and Paste a screenshot with Ctrl+V; the local AI reads it.
